Backend: Get project members returns user list for @mentions
Backend: Create comment with @mention text works

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: ReferenceError: members is not defined - caused task detail dialog to crash

updated_files: /app/tests/test_bug_fixes.py - Created comprehensive test file for bug fixes
seed_data_creation: Created test checklist items during testing (TEST_Checklist_UI_6183)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 reported bugs/features have been verified: 1) Checklist items now save correctly using subtasks field, 2) File upload no longer shows spurious error (backend removes _id from response), 3) @mentions UI with autocomplete is working - typing @ shows team member suggestions. A critical bug was found and fixed: ProjectDetailPage.jsx was using undefined 'members' variable instead of 'projectMembers' state variable, causing the task detail dialog to crash.

bug_1_checklist_saving.details: Frontend loads checklist from task.subtasks || task.checklist. Backend stores in subtasks field. Add/toggle/delete all work correctly.

bug_2_file_upload_error.details: Backend removes _id field from attachment response after insert_one. Frontend FileAttachments component has improved error handling.

feature_mentions_ui.details: MentionInput component shows autocomplete dropdown when typing @. Shows team members with name, email, and avatar. Keyboard navigation supported.
